The Challenge

  • Data was fragmented across sales, marketing, customer support and operations systems.
  • Leadership needed a clear view of performance across channels, fulfillment and retention.
  • Limited visibility into real-time performance and operational efficiency.
  • Teams spent more time preparing reports than acting on them.

The Solution

  • Built a centralized analytics dashboard with a single source of truth across key business areas.
  • Unified KPIs and definitions to ensure consistency and comparability.
  • Near-real-time data pipeline for timely monitoring and alerts.
  • Clear, actionable insights tailored to business users.

My Contribution

  • Defined success metrics and KPI framework with stakeholders.
  • Led discovery, requirements gathering and dashboard scope.
  • Designed data model and KPI logic in collaboration with the team.
  • Coordinated data integration and dashboard implementation.
  • Validated data quality and monitored performance after launch.
  • Led user training, documentation and stakeholder rollout.
